title: VTG 1999 Disney Toy Story 2 Chirstmas Ornament From Disney - Wrong Box Included
descriptionText: The product is a VTG 1999 Disney Toy Story 2 Christmas ornament from Disney. It features characters from the Toy Story franchise, specifically from the second installment released in 1999. The ornament is made of plastic and was manufactured in China. This collectible item is a nostalgic piece from the Disney Pixar movie that captures the essence of the beloved story. It would make a great addition to any Disney or Toy Story collection, especially for fans who appreciate vintage items from the late 90s.
